name: Earlham College
academic_ranking: Private liberal arts college (Quaker-affiliated, founded 1847). Ranked #74 among National Liberal Arts Colleges by U.S. News & World Report. Small enrollment (~677 students) with strong science research focus and heavy study-abroad participation (~70% of students).
financial_aid: Tuition is the same for in-state and out-of-state students ($56,784 for 2026-27; total billed cost of attendance ~$73,526). Both merit-based scholarships (all applicants automatically considered) and need-based aid (via FAFSA) offered, including grants, loans, and Federal College Work-Study. INspire Earlham program offers free tuition to Pell- and Indiana-grant-eligible Indiana students with family income up to $60,000. Early Decision applicants receive a $3k/year scholarship.
facilities_notes: Softball program competes as the Earlham Quakers; team X account @Quaker_Softball. Specific softball facility details not confirmed on official pages checked 2026-07.
program_reputation: NCAA Division III program in the Heartland Collegiate Athletic Conference (HCAC). As a D3 program, no athletic scholarships are offered; recruiting emphasizes academics and need/merit-based financial aid.
notes: Data sourced from goearlham.com softball coaches and roster pages and earlham.edu cost pages, verified 2026-07. Roster size of 24 taken from 2026 softball roster page. D3 programs do not award athletic scholarships, so scholarship_count is null.
